svg.title: How to check access to a project file
svg.desc: A team keeps a practice handbook in a project. Someone can start a session and still lack permission to read that file. Who starts it. Identify the person or service account and what that account may request. Which team. Check that the session belongs to the organization responsible for the project. Which files. Check the project grant. Try the same harmless handbook file with the practice user and the approved service account.
svg.text: How to check access to a project file
A team keeps a practice handbook in a project. Someone can start a session
and still lack permission to read that file.
Identify the person or service account and what that account may request.
Check that the session belongs to the organization responsible for the project.
Check the project grant. Try the same harmless handbook file with the practice user
